title: A Comprehensive Survey on Multi-Agent Cooperative Decision-Making: Scenarios, Approaches, Challenges and Perspectives
abstract: arXiv:2503.13415v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, intelligent decision-making techniques have gradually surpassed human levels in various human-machine competitions, especially in complex multi-agent cooperative task scenarios. Multi-agent cooperative decision-making involves multiple agents working together to complete established tasks and achieve specific objectives. These techniques are widely applicable in real-world scenarios such as autonomous driving, drone navigation, disaster rescue, and simulated military confrontations. This paper begins with a comprehensive survey of the leading simulation environments and platforms used for multi-agent cooperative decision-making. Specifically, we provide an in-depth analysis for these simulation environments from various perspectives, including task formats, reward allocation, and the underlying technologies employed. translated_title: 多智能体协同决策的全面综述：场景、方法、挑战与展望
translated_abstract: 随着人工智能的快速发展，智能决策技术在各类人机对抗中逐渐超越人类水平，尤其是在复杂的多智能体协同任务场景中。多智能体协同决策是指多个智能体共同协作以完成既定任务并实现特定目标，这些技术广泛应用于自动驾驶、无人机导航、灾害救援和模拟军事对抗等现实场景。本文首先对多智能体协同决策领域的主流仿真环境和平台进行了全面综述，具体而言，我们从任务形式、奖励分配以及所采用的底层技术等多个角度对这些仿真环境进行了深入分析。随后，我们对……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文全面综述了多智能体协同决策领域，从任务形式、奖励分配和底层技术等角度深入分析了主流仿真环境与平台，并系统梳理了该领域的应用场景、方法、挑战与未来展望。
